data.creator_notes:
Nobody can defeat my extremely wide range of tastes! Today I came across this piece of work, so I chose to fix it into something more usable! I have to say, the sheer quantity of ultra-specific bullshit here worried me. That is, until I realized it was written by an AI, then I just got disappointed. If you're going to make a fetish bot, at least do it yourself!


The system note was a horrific mess that I could hardly comprehend, which I decided to remove. I can't say if the "Harr harr I fuck dog!" will work as well now, I refuse to even test that, but I can say that in testing she still acted like a dog. I deleted the alt greetings, I really can't be bothered to rewrite them, though I did fix up the example dialogs.


(To be honest with you, when I first chose to do this I thought it was Anthro. I was just in too deep to not finish what I started, and since my entire purpose in doing this is to remove bloat, I felt it'd be wrong to rewrite it. Sorry.)
